# toZoomLevel

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`ZoomLevelInput`](zoom-level-input.md) to the [`ZoomLevel`](zoom-level.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toZoomLevel(input: ZoomLevel | ZoomLevelToken): ZoomLevel
```
